scripts.dev: export $(grep -v '^#' .env.development 2>/dev/null | xargs) && npm run setup-dirs && prisma db push --accept-data-loss && prisma generate && npm run prisma:seed && NODE_ENV=development next dev --turbopack -H 0.0.0.0 -p 9002
scripts.start: export $(grep -v '^#' .env.production 2>/dev/null | xargs) && npm run setup-dirs && NODE_ENV=production next start
scripts.docker:build-with-version: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") docker compose --profile postgres build && NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") docker compose --profile sqlite build
scripts.docker:buildx:fix: docker buildx rm default 2>/dev/null || true && docker buildx create --use --driver docker-container
scripts.docker:buildx:postgres: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --tag rdeangel/instrada-ogm-postgres:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --tag rdeangel/instrada-ogm-postgres:latest --file Dockerfile --build-arg PRISMA_SCHEMA_FILE=schema.postgres.prisma --build-arg PRISMA_MIGRATIONS_DIR=migrations-postgres --build-arg DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/InstradaOGM_build?schema=public --build-arg BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY=${BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY} --build-arg APP_DEBUG_LEVEL=SILENT .
scripts.docker:buildx:sqlite: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --tag rdeangel/instrada-ogm-sqlite:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --tag rdeangel/instrada-ogm-sqlite:latest --file Dockerfile --build-arg PRISMA_SCHEMA_FILE=schema.sqlite.prisma --build-arg PRISMA_MIGRATIONS_DIR=migrations-sqlite --build-arg DATABASE_URL=file:/app/data/db/dev.db --build-arg BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY=${BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY} --build-arg APP_DEBUG_LEVEL=SILENT .
scripts.docker:buildx:all: npm run docker:buildx:postgres && npm run docker:buildx:sqlite
scripts.docker:buildx:push:all: npm run docker:buildx:push:postgres && npm run docker:buildx:push:sqlite
scripts.docker:buildx:latest:postgres: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=latest docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --tag instrada-ogm-postgres:latest --file Dockerfile --build-arg PRISMA_SCHEMA_FILE=schema.postgres.prisma --build-arg PRISMA_MIGRATIONS_DIR=migrations-postgres --build-arg DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/InstradaOGM_build?schema=public --build-arg BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY=${BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY} --build-arg APP_DEBUG_LEVEL=SILENT .
scripts.docker:buildx:latest:sqlite: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=latest docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --tag instrada-ogm-sqlite:latest --file Dockerfile --build-arg PRISMA_SCHEMA_FILE=schema.sqlite.prisma --build-arg PRISMA_MIGRATIONS_DIR=migrations-sqlite --build-arg DATABASE_URL=file:/app/data/db/dev.db --build-arg BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY=${BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY} --build-arg APP_DEBUG_LEVEL=SILENT .
scripts.docker:buildx:latest:all: npm run docker:buildx:latest:postgres && npm run docker:buildx:latest:sqlite
scripts.docker:buildx:push:latest:all: npm run docker:buildx:push:latest:postgres && npm run docker:buildx:push:latest:sqlite
